story 命中 1 个高风险信号: 生产环境/紧急。建议用更严格的审查标准（≥ 3 preMortem 场景、明确的回滚路径）。 若本 story 只是提及而非修改该领域（误报），可 koala story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-aa98","category":"<分类>","reason":"..."}' 完整回退 auto-elevation（全部 auto-elevated riskSignal 被 dismiss 后 priority 自动回退、高风险 gate 解除）。

understanding 还有 3 个未消化的 unknowns: Whether Claude Code CLI is installed on this machine is environment-dependent and must degrade to unavailable/warn.; Exact non-interactive Claude Code invocation is host/vendor-specific, so first release should keep supervised dispatch as conservative projection.; Receipt integration should be local and gate-visible without implying server authority.
